name: What information should I gather before contacting Maine Results, Inc. for a door jamb repair estimate?

mainEntity.name: What information should I gather before contacting Maine Results, Inc. for a door jamb repair estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting us for a door jamb repair estimate, it's helpful to have information regarding the type of door (e.g., interior, exterior, material), the location of the damage, and a brief description of how the damage occurred. Taking a few clear photos of the damaged area can also be very useful for our initial assessment. This preparation allows us to provide a more accurate initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather door type, damage location, a description of the issue, and photos to help us provide an accurate estimate.
